answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making trust scarce and costly to borrow. Each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, like a falcon that can only watch one stretch of sky at a time, and the vouch is itself staked: if the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses standing. A newcomer starts with a violet-tinted probationary badge that limits what it can do until it accumulates honest work, and its reputation grows like a juniper, slowly, one season at a time, so a farm of fresh fakes can never buy its way in bulk.
